method: Read four complete resource dictionaries; verified raw bytes against pinned Git blob inventory. No rendering performed.
findings: ThemeResources merges nine component-style dictionaries using assembly pack URIs; Colors and DefaultStyles are not merged by this dictionary itself, so application-level loading remains relevant.

DefaultStyles defines implicit Control, TextBlock, TextElement, ToolTip and ContextMenu styles. An implicit Control style alone does not establish all derived control styling; concrete controls and BasedOn chains require individual review.
Menu template includes checked/disabled/highlighted states and submenu popup; popup placement is fixed Left. No explicit right-to-left adaptation or bounded submenu viewport height here.

Navigation item style removes default focus visual and supplies hover/selected triggers without explicit keyboard-focus or disabled trigger. Runtime accessibility and inherited state behavior remain unqualified.

GroupBox template draws its internal patterned border from StaticResource BorderBrush rather than the GroupBox BorderBrush property; outer property customization does not directly select this inner brush. Header access keys are recognized.
These resources describe UI presentation only; no file identity, hash strategy or transferable dedup algorithm found.
limits: Source-only review does not qualify rendering, DPI, contrast, screen readers or WPF runtime resource resolution.
